manual_reviewer_checklist.scope_note: Shortened 2026-10-16 to the supported range: minimum 1280x720 logical, smallest device 1366x768. Live drag preview stays with L3-003.

items.step: Real 1366x768 device at 100%, 125% and 150% Windows DPI: the window starts fully on screen, the status bar and command line are above the taskbar, left rail, four viewports and command panel are visible and not overlapped.
items.machine_proven: Pure sizing function and the MinInnerSize command on the first frame (window_minimum.rs); frame contract at 1280x720, 1366x728, 1093x585, 911x480 (SIMULATED); real-window lap100/lap125/lap150 with a SIMULATED 1366x768 monitor and audit zoom (SIMULATED).
items.human_must_verify: A maximized/normal start on a real 1366x768 device at each DPI; the usable area is only estimated (monitor minus 16 x 80 pt).

items.step: Window-minimum enforcement by dragging an edge: the window stops at 1280x720 logical (or the capped value on a small screen) and cannot be shrunk further.
items.machine_proven: The app sends ViewportCommand::MinInnerSize(effective) on frame 0 and on a monitor change (headless frame test); startup refuses a window below 1280x720 (real exe, exit 1, no receipt).
items.human_must_verify: That Windows actually enforces the size while a person drags, and that the window does not jump.

items.step: Second monitor with a different DPI: move the window; the minimum follows and nothing overlaps.
items.machine_proven: Changing the monitor between frames emits exactly one new MinInnerSize command (headless).
items.human_must_verify: A real second monitor and per-monitor DPI.

items.step: Right dock shows from 1200 logical points and yields below it with a notice in the CMD history and status bar; the command line cannot be lost.
items.machine_proven: Boundary tests at 1199/1199.99/1200 (pure planner, dock_layout, full frame sweep 1150..=1250); hidden command line is kept (CommandInputKept) through the layout API.
items.human_must_verify: The menu or mouse path for the right dock and the visual result; whether Matrix9 should have an optional right dock at all (the Matrix9 screenshot rule shows none; the user decides).

items.step: Read the bottom status line at the minimum (1280x720, and the capped 911x480 case).
items.machine_proven: status_bar_overlap and size-matrix rect tests; receipt status_text_overlap false with non-null status_message_px and status_summary_px in every real-window case; screenshots viewed by the agent.
items.human_must_verify: Whether the elided text is readable enough.

The egui command input line ends about 3 px below the plan command_input rectangle at normal sizes (frame margins); tolerated at 8 px as in tests/workbench_regions.rs.
